members.name: Required capital amount
members.definition: A monetary capital requirement, including a disclosed additional capital charge. Distinct from risk-weighted assets; no implicit conversion between the two.

members.name: Reported share
members.definition: A source-reported proportion of an explicitly labelled total, with numerator and denominator retained in the source context.

members.name: Change in CET1 capital ratio
members.definition: A disclosed change in the CET1 capital ratio, distinct from its level; direction, estimate status and effective date remain source-specific.
